rendering.content_transform: Arthur loader applies Python str.strip() to prompt and response before rendering
rendering.format: separately encode <|begin_of_text|>, each <|start_header_id|>{role}<|end_header_id|>\n\n header, and each {content}<|eot_id|> output chunk
rendering.completion_labels: assistant response plus <|eot_id|>, excluding the assistant header

data_order.composition: epoch indices select from load-shuffled rows

loss.accumulation: sum unscaled one-example mean losses; no division by effective batch or partial final group

intentional_local_differences.lora_initialization: deterministic local torch seed; historical Tinker server-side adapter matrices were not reproducibly seeded
intentional_local_differences.overlength_policy: fail closed rather than truncate or skip; current corpus must contain zero overlength rows
intentional_local_differences.physical_batching: 128 sequential one-example forwards with summed gradients rather than one remote physical batch
intentional_local_differences.checkpoint_format: PEFT adapter plus tokenizer and optimizer/scheduler state rather than Tinker state plus sampler weights
